environment.description: IoT gateway device running Debian 11 (bullseye) on ARM64, containerized with Docker using --privileged flag for hardware access. Process runs as root inside container. MQTT broker (Mosquitto) accepts connections from field engineer VPN subnet (10.8.0.0/24) without client certificate authentication. MSG_SECRET is set to a weak default value 'field-ops-2023' shared across fleet.
